newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries slightly up in moderate midday trade.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries slightly up in moderate midday trade.

text.p: U.S. Treasury prices were slightly higher at midday on Thursday after getting a bunch of fresh economic data that mostly fit the idea that economic growth was slowing and inflation was subdued.

The Labor Department said its Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.3 percent rise for October and that the core CPI, the index minus its volatile food and energy items, rose just 0.2 percent. Those modest gains matched the consensus forecast offered by economists in a Reuters survey.
